domain.value: 3D causal video VAEs of the Wan2.1 / Wan2.2 text/image-to-video diffusion models; Wan2.1-VAE inflated from a 2D image VAE and trained on videos from a general-domain curated pool (internal copyrighted + publicly accessible sources)

quotes.quote: Wan -VAE can compress the spatio-temporal dimension of a video by 4 × 8 × 8 4\times 8\times 8 times.

First, we construct a 2D image VAE with the same structure and train it on image data. Then, we inflate the well-trained 2D image VAE into a 3D causal Wan -VAE to provide an initial spatial compression prior, which drastically improves the training speed compared to training a video VAE from scratch. At this stage, Wan -VAE is trained on the low-resolution (128 × \times 128) and small frame number (5-frame) videos to accelerate convergence speed.
3.1 Pre-training Data We curated and deduplicated a candidate dataset sourced from both internal copyrighted sources and publicly accessible data.

pretraining_data.summary: Candidate dataset 'sourced from both internal copyrighted sources and publicly accessible data', billions of images and videos, curated by a four-step cleaning pipeline; VAE: 2D image VAE on image data, then 128x128 5-frame videos, then high-quality videos. Wan2.2: +65.6% images, +83.2% videos vs Wan2.1. No datasets named.

quotes.quote: 3.1 Pre-training Data We curated and deduplicated a candidate dataset sourced from both internal copyrighted sources and publicly accessible data.
Following these principles, we curated a dataset comprising billions of videos and images.

First, we construct a 2D image VAE with the same structure and train it on image data. Then, we inflate the well-trained 2D image VAE into a 3D causal Wan -VAE to provide an initial spatial compression prior, which drastically improves the training speed compared to training a video VAE from scratch. At this stage, Wan -VAE is trained on the low-resolution (128 × \times 128) and small frame number (5-frame) videos to accelerate convergence speed.
Finally, we fine-tune the model on high-quality videos with different resolutions and frame numbers, integrating the GAN loss ( Esser et al., 2021 ) from a 3D discriminator.
Compared to Wan2.1, Wan2.2 is trained on a significantly larger data, with +65.6% more images and +83.2% more videos.
